_about: Per-metric change thresholds shared by the Nightly Kernel Checks page
(the THRESHOLDS constant in index.html, which test_kernel_checks_page.py
keeps equal to this file) and pr_report.py. A change of at least `pct`
percent of the previous value counts, or any change at all when `pct` is
0: the page colors it, the report lists it. `gated` metrics are the
regressions a report leads with; a `derived` metric repeats another and
is not compared. The hardware numbers come from two nightlies of one
commit: cycles and the byte sizes moved by well under 1% or not at all,
npu_us by 17% at the 90th percentile on npu1. The static (compiler
remark) counts are exact, so any increase is the compiler's; program
memory gets the slack the remarks module documents.
